crossRefs.note: For if a man thinks himself to be something when he is nothing, he deceives himself.
Let him not trust in emptiness, deceiving himself; for emptiness will be his reward.
“Yahweh says, ‘Don’t deceive yourselves, saying, “The Chaldeans will surely depart from us;” for they will not depart.
The pride of your heart has deceived you, you who dwell in the clefts of the rock, whose habitation is high, who says…
He said, “Watch out that you don’t get led astray, for many will come in my name, saying, ‘I am he,’ and, ‘The time is…
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he…
Or don’t you know that the unrighteous will not inherit God’s Kingdom? Don’t be deceived. Neither the sexually immoral…
Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
Let no one deceive you with empty words. For because of these things, the wrath of God comes on the children of…
Let no one deceive you in any way. For it will not be, unless the rebellion comes first, and the man of sin is…
But be doers of the word, and not only hearers, deluding your own selves.
If anyone among you thinks himself to be religious while he doesn’t bridle his tongue, but deceives his heart, this…
If we say that we have no sin, we deceive ourselves, and the truth is not in us.
Little children, let no one lead you astray. He who does righteousness is righteous, even as he is righteous.
Will you show partiality to him? Will you contend for God?
Is it good that he should search you out? Or as one deceives a man, will you deceive him?
They said to you, “In the last time there will be mockers, walking after their own ungodly lusts.”
According to what I have seen, those who plow iniquity, and sow trouble, reap the same.
Therefore they will eat of the fruit of their own way, and be filled with their own schemes.
in whose heart is perverseness, who devises evil continually, who always sows discord.
a false witness who utters lies, and he who sows discord among brothers.
Wicked people earn deceitful wages, but one who sows righteousness reaps a sure reward.
For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it…
Sow to yourselves in righteousness, reap according to kindness. Break up your fallow ground; for it is time to seek…
“But Abraham said, ‘Son, remember that you, in your lifetime, received your good things, and Lazarus, in the same way…
who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”
Remember this: he who sows sparingly will also reap sparingly. He who sows bountifully will also reap bountifully.

translations.web: Don’t be deceived. God is not mocked, for whatever a man sows, that he will also reap.
translations.bsb: Do not be deceived: God is not to be mocked. Whatever a man sows, he will reap in return.
translations.kjv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
translations.asv: Be not deceived; God is not mocked: for whatsoever a man soweth, that shall he also reap.
